question: Who among the following in NOT the founding members of the United Nation?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Germany**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Germany** is not a founding member of the United Nations.
 
• The United Nations was established on 24 October 1945, following the end of World War II, with the aim of preventing future conflicts and fostering international cooperation.
 
• The original founding members of the United Nations include countries such as the USA, France, the Soviet Union, and China, among others.
 
• Germany joined the United Nations much later, becoming a member on 18 September 1973.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **The United Nations** is an international organization founded in 1945 and currently made up of 193 Member States.
 
• The mission and work of the United Nations are guided by the purposes and principles contained in its founding Charter.
 
• The UN has evolved over the years to keep pace with a rapidly changing world.
 
• Its work touches every corner of the globe and includes maintaining international peace and security, protecting human rights, delivering humanitarian aid, promoting sustainable development, and upholding international law.
